texts.name: Slash
texts.biography: Slash was an old drinking buddy of Crag Hack back in Enroth. He came to Erathia to hide from constables who wanted to question him about some peasants with whom he had a falling out. Once in Erathia he was promptly arrested for cheating at cards.

specialty.description: receives a 5% per level bonus to his Armorer skill percentage.
specialty.name: Armorer
